name: Pranav Agarwal
greeting: Hello, I’m a frontend engineer from India building for web, mobile and AI tooling!

experience.description: An LLM-powered interface that answers experience questions, an app sync engine for offline ticket data, and an internal app debugging tool.
Web-to-app handoff (+61% app adoption, +33% retention), personalised homepages (+20% conversion, 60% faster), a shared A/B testing framework, and push nudges that took opt-in from 18% to 38%.
Moved the mailing and ticketing systems from JSP to Next.js, and sent payment receipts to customers automatically.
A call automation API for the IVR, so calls arrive with the customer’s context.
A GDPR-compliant candidate sourcing platform and recruitment automation that made sourcing-to-hire 70% more efficient.

education.degree: B.Tech, Computer Science & Engineering (Cyber Security & Forensics)
education.school: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies

interests: Frontend performance, AI-native developer tools, design, and travel
aboutHtml:
I’m a senior frontend engineer at Headout, working across the React Native app and the Next.js web: an LLM-powered assistant that answers questions about experiences, an offline sync engine for tickets, and the web-to-app journey that grew app adoption by 61%.

Outside work I build things I want to use myself: NomadSafe, a travel companion app, and grain, a tool for reviewing pull requests as user flows. Most days that means React, Next.js, React Native and TypeScript, with some Rust and Go when the problem asks for it.
